NaAudio__Pattern__Meta.Name: Pentatonic Walk
NaAudio__Pattern__Meta.Author: Adam Noble - Noble Architecture
NaAudio__Pattern__Meta.Description: The eight-degree figure the CubeMod plays on its own when SelfPlay is on. Written out here so the same line can be handed to any other tonal module.
NaAudio__Pattern__Meta.DegreeNote: Degrees are scale degrees, not semitones. Degree 5 in a five-note scale is the root an octave up, so a walk can run past the end of the scale and keep climbing - see NaAudio__MusicalMaths__ScaleDegreeToMidi.
